exposure: Source reproduction and follow-ups seen; independent atlas publication, dataset inventory and cell metadata seen; external gene effects not inspected before this contract.
question: Does the alveolar-versus-adventitial C3 contrast transfer more consistently than a generalized chemokine direction in an independent normal-lung dataset?
primary_population: normal single cells in Lower Left Lobe or Upper left lobe; retain those exact anatomical locations separately in matched strata
secondary_population: nuclei in the same explicit lobe locations; exclude Mix and all airway locations; assay-separated technical context only
expression: raw/X integer nonnegative counts, exact feature_name mapping, all-curated-gene library sums; log2(CPM+1) pseudobulk differences left minus right
donor_summary: Equal mean of within-donor eligible assay/location/protocol stratum effects, separately for cells and nuclei. Donors, not strata, form the summary unit; show all stratum effects and heterogeneity.
interpretation: Independent study cohort; annotation still source-defined and related to published markers. This is a descriptive external transfer pilot, not an untouched confirmatory experiment or a test of injury response.
outcomes: Report individual donor directions, mean/range and cohort eligibility. No threshold search, biological p-values, score reweighting or causal RQ promotion.
